_what_this_is: A DERIVED semantic record of the physical `main.py` under the Quantum CNS mandate. No executable implementation; replaces nothing; `main.py` is untouched.
_revision: FOURTH EDITION. The third pass attacked the FORM rather than its contents, and the form failed. Six of seven attacks landed as FUNDAMENTAL, including the one finding that looked local and did not survive its own locality proof. One recorded negative claim was proved FALSE by evidence that had been in the repository since pass 2 discovered the file it lives in. The promotion criterion was attacked as instructed and is now recorded as FALSIFIED. Still NOT a schema — and now with a demonstrated reason why no schema may be derived yet.

_adversarial_history.pass_1_2026_08_08: Five challenges, all upheld: an observer was two, a state space was missing, an equivalence class was named after an ambiguous boundary, a source-derived description passed for semantics, an exhaustiveness claim had no method.
_adversarial_history.pass_2_2026_08_08: Six challenges. Verdicts, each decided by probe before any wording changed: (1) SPLIT — the internal control quotient was still one level too coarse; (2) SURVIVES with the evidence class corrected — the second edition had UNDERSTATED its own evidence; (3) REPRESENTATION ERROR — a hypothetical observer sat among evidenced ones; (4) SURVIVES, and the recorded 'gap' is WITHDRAWN as my own search failure; (5) REPRESENTATION ERROR — two spaces implied impossible states; (6) DOWNGRADED — static-import isolation was being read as runtime isolation.
_adversarial_history.pass_3_2026_08_08: Seven attacks on the FORM, its provenance, and its own promotion criterion. Results: (1) temporal identity — FUNDAMENTAL, proved by probe QT1; (2) subject ownership — FUNDAMENTAL, and the same defect as (1) seen from the other side; (3) totality of quotients — FUNDAMENTAL, no observer declares a domain; (4) negative claims — FUNDAMENTAL, and one such claim was FALSE; (5) protection independence — FUNDAMENTAL, 8 reds were 2 independent observations; (6) the external consumer — FUNDAMENTAL, one consumer instantiates two observer classes and the form cannot hold that; (7) the promotion criterion — FALSIFIED by self-demonstration.
_adversarial_history._note_on_the_third_pass: Passes 1 and 2 examined what the file SAID. Pass 3 examined what the file CAN say. Every dimension pass 3 opened had been unexamined in both prior passes, and five of them contained fundamental defects the whole time. This is itself the evidence used to falsify the promotion criterion.

snapshot_binding._origin: ADDED after attack 1. This is an EXPERIMENT, not a proposed field shape — the correct shape is unknown and deriving one is forbidden until the form stabilises. It exists so that the file's claims stop being undated assertions about a moving repository.
snapshot_binding.what_this_does_NOT_solve: It records WHEN the claims were true. It does not detect staleness, does not fail anything, and no ratchet checks it. A reader who trusts it must verify the hashes themselves.

physical_subject._origin: RE-STATED after attack 2 was upheld. The previous editions named `main.py` as the subject while nearly every load-bearing claim was about code outside it.
physical_subject.body: one statement — `return run_cli()` — plus the module tail `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())`
physical_subject.actual_subject_of_the_claims: NOT main.py's bytes. main.py contributes exactly two facts to this whole record — that it delegates, and that the tail converts the returned value into SystemExit. Everything else — which payloads are reachable, what code 2 means, which variants exist, who consumes the result — is a property of the PROCESS ROOTED AT main.py, whose behaviour lives in cli/app.py, cli/one_shot.py, cli/repl.py, cli/resume.py and cli/command_dispatch.py.
physical_subject.why_this_matters: Attack 1 proved it is not a wording quibble: probe QT1 edited a `return 2` path in cli/app.py to `return 3`, main.py stayed byte-identical (def397b4c33e51d3 before and after), all 8 tests in test_main_public_surface.py stayed green, and this file's payload-exhaustiveness claim became false. A record whose subject is one file but whose claims are owned by five cannot express its own invalidation.
physical_subject.status: OPEN FUNDAMENTAL. The snapshot_binding above is a stopgap, not a resolution: it pins the sources but does not make the file's subject coherent.

outcome_space._origin: REPLACES the second edition's two separate spaces (main_termination_mode × main_return_value). Challenge 5 was upheld: a Cartesian product of those two implies states that cannot exist — PROPAGATED_SYSTEMEXIT has no return value at all, and RETURNED has no exception code. The minimal representation that admits no impossible combination is ONE space of tagged variants, each carrying its own payload. Derived from the traced control flow, not adopted from the proposal.

explicitly_not_claimed: No identity between argparse's SystemExit codes and the RETURNED payload — the same integers in different variants of one tagged space.
No claim that the variants are equivalent because their process codes can coincide.
No design change. main being a pass-through, an identity carrier and a transparent conduit are observations.
No claim that snapshot_binding is the right shape for temporal binding. It is a stopgap whose shape is deliberately unjustified.

schema_status: NOT A SCHEMA. Three adversarial passes. The first found five errors of content, the second two outright failures and four partial, the third six fundamental defects of FORM in dimensions neither earlier pass had opened. The form has now been shown to be unable to express: its own subject, its own validity window, the domain of a quotient, the independence of its protection evidence, the epistemic status of a negative, and a consumer occupying two observer classes. That is not a file that needs another edit. It is a form that has not been designed yet.

promotion_criterion.verdict: FALSIFIED — attacked as instructed rather than satisfied, and it did not survive.
promotion_criterion.superseded_criterion: THIRD EDITION: 'Promotion to a general Quantum File format requires a pass whose findings are ALL local by the above test.' Preserved as audit evidence.

falsifications.name: the criterion measures the attacker, not the artifact
falsifications.argument: 'A pass whose findings are all local' leaves the pass as a free variable and constrains nothing about its coverage. Passes 1 and 2 never opened temporal identity, subject ownership, quotient totality, negative-claim method, protection independence, or consumer characterisation. Five of those six contained fundamental defects the entire time.
falsifications.self_demonstration: Had pass 3 been a citation-checking pass, its findings would all have been local and this file would have been promoted with every one of those defects intact. The criterion cannot distinguish a stable artifact from an unexamined dimension.

falsifications.name: the classifier is inside the artifact under test
falsifications.argument: FUNDAMENTAL vs LOCAL is decided by the same agent that wrote the claims, against a definition stored in the file being judged. Promotion is reachable by editing `what_counts_as_LOCAL`. The third edition already shows the drift: pass 2's evidence-direction errors were filed as 'borderline', a category the criterion does not define.

falsifications.name: 'all local' rewards a lucky pass
falsifications.argument: The criterion is a conjunction over one pass, so promotion probability rises as attacks get shallower or the attacker tires. It is monotone in exactly the wrong direction: it should become harder to satisfy as the artifact absorbs more structure, and instead it becomes easier to satisfy as scrutiny drops.

falsifications.name: it certifies a snapshot as if it were durable
falsifications.argument: Probe QT1 showed a claim in this file can go false with ZERO edits to the file and zero edits to its named subject. A criterion phrased entirely in terms of adversarial passes says nothing about a truth-value that decays between them.

falsifications.name: 'LOCAL' failed its own locality proof on the one candidate that had it
falsifications.argument: The operator required that a LOCAL finding be shown not to change the shape of how another Quantum File would represent the same category of fact. Attack 6 produced the only finding that looked local — one word, HYPOTHETICAL_CLASS to INSTANTIATED. Recording it CORRECTLY requires expressing that one consumer occupies two observer classes at two internal surfaces, and that it collapses RETURNED(0) with PROPAGATED_SYSTEMEXIT(0). The observers section is a flat observer→evidence map with no concept of a consumer. Any Quantum File with a cross-process or cross-language consumer meets the same wall. The finding is therefore FUNDAMENTAL, and the pass contains ZERO proven-local findings.
falsifications.consequence: The LOCAL/FUNDAMENTAL distinction is not merely hard to apply — under the operator's own proof obligation, the only candidate that presented as local dissolved on inspection.

promotion_criterion.what_replaces_it: NOTHING YET, deliberately. Writing a better criterion now would repeat the error the criterion was guarding against: deriving a general rule from a subject that is still collapsing. What can be said without inventing anything: any future criterion must be indexed to a NAMED set of attack dimensions rather than to 'a pass', must survive being applied by someone other than the artifact's author, and must have a way of expiring when the sources change. Those are three requirements, not a criterion.
